name: Rochester (Minnesota, United States)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the city seal: the city skyline with Canada geese on a light blue disc, in a white ring reading ROCHESTER MINN.
history: Rochester is a city in and the county seat of Olmsted County, Minnesota. The flag was adopted on 16 June 1980 (the design by Sue Muir, a fine-arts student at the Minneapolis College of Art and Design, was selected by the Rochester City Council on 16 June 1980, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: city seal, the city skyline with Canada geese on a light blue disc, in a ring reading ROCHESTER MINN.
